name: cfcmt-bus-cross-city-offline-pilot-v1
prerequisite: bus_cross_city_native_v1 target pool READY; bus_thesis_rule_confirmation_v1 PASS
purpose: Fixed target few-shot budget diagnostic of whether source-city controller initialization improves confidence-weighted target-model learning.

branches.target_only: Target-fit IQL initialization and adaptation; real target-fit H2O+ continuation with a SAC actor.
branches.target_model: Identical target initialization and adaptation; confidence-weighted one-step target world-model continuation.
branches.cross_city: Source IQL initialization replaces target initialization; reset city identity and arrival-rate input columns; identical target adaptation and target-model continuation.

method_boundary: Offline learned-target-model diagnostic; not a reproduction of Thesis live low-fidelity interaction or proof of physical sim-to-real. No new training simulator events.

training.model_stop_role: stop only; choose within fixed fitting iterations
training.model_calibrate_role: diagnostics only; no controller or family selection
training.source_arrival_rate_feature: Omitted in all source state slots because causal historical arrivals cannot be recovered; target observed arrivals retained
training.checkpoint_rule: Fixed final controller checkpoint, with no evaluation-based selection
training.continuation_backup: Existing H2O+ mixed backup: 0.1 value + 0.9 SAC, with online_fraction=0 and ratio correction disabled; actual and synthetic branches share it.

budget.source_selection: 68 per sorted source_shard_id; first64 shards get69. Equally spaced original transition rows including both endpoints, never select on reward.
budget.compute: Same per-route update history. Identical target initializer and target world model are physically reused between target_only/target_model and target_model/cross_city respectively.
budget.interpretation: Cross-city replaces target initialization; it is a replacement comparison under equal update counts, not identical target gradient exposure plus free source pretraining.

evaluation.test_separation: New fixed demand/SUMO seed realizations, disjoint from fit/stop/calibrate; same pinned timetable and generated route corridors.
evaluation.comparison: Three training seeds, three paired generated demand days; retain every branch/day/seed and compare all-seed means.
evaluation.completion: Report completion rate and departed/completed counts alongside cost.
evaluation.interpretation: Bounded pilot on one target city; no population-level CI or city removal.

decision: Report fixed-final results for all branches versus the strong rule and cross_city minus target_model. Do not retune seeds, coefficients, transfer columns or source subset based on the test outcomes.
